message.content: A minimalist graphic illustration dominates the square frame, featuring a large, perfectly circular shape rendered in a vibrant, saturated red hue. This red circle is positioned precisely in the center of the composition, set against a plain, uniform white background that extends to the very edges of the image. The contrast between the bold red circle and the stark white field is sharp and clean, creating a striking visual impact. The entire composition is characterized by its geometric simplicity and lack of texture, shadows, or gradients, giving it a clean, modern, and symbolic appearance, closely resembling the national flag of Japan, also known as the Nisshōki or Hinomaru.
